title: The Hedge Maze
text: A hedge maze in the middle of nowhere, perfectly kept, its walls trimmed square and dark green and taller than a horse. No gardener in sight. At its heart, by the way the hedges lean inward, something worth finding, and something that does not want to be found.

options.label: The cleverest leads the way through, determined to reach its heart.

outcomes.text: Straight to the heart, and a fountain with coins in it, and no gardener. Not that you can see.
The maze changes behind you, quietly, and keeps changing, and something walks the paths you left.

options.label: The strongest cuts straight through the hedges. No maze will hold you.

outcomes.text: The hedges bleed red sap, and the gardener is very upset, and very close.

options.label: Go around it, and leave its heart to whatever guards it.

outcomes.text: It is a very big maze, and it seems to get bigger as you walk.
